messages:
rachael: FYI customer reported a regression after last night's rollout — instructions at the top of very long chats are being ignored/truncated. They say it worked before the deploy. attaching convo + request id. :frowning:
devon: can you paste a minimal repro and the request_id? also which model variant are they on? :eyes:
rachael: conversation excerpt (customer redacted):\n\nUser: "System: You are a strict policy assistant. Always output a numbered list for steps."
User: "Please summarize the legal process and provide three required forms."
Assistant (current): "Here's a brief summary..." (no numbered list, missing forms)\n\nrequest_id: r-0a3b9c2f
model: redwood-rt-2.0-q4f16
notes: happens only on threads > ~16k tokens per customer
samir: thanks. does this happen on canary or only rollout-prod? we had a kernels patch merged yesterday (gpu-kernel/kv-evict) that touched KV eviction heuristics. :thinking:
kai: also check batching config — aggressive continuous batching + short kv retention could evict system prompt prefixes earlier. what are the runtime params for this customer? rachael can you dump the route config and batch settings for that org id?
rachael: org: acme-inc, route: /v1/chat.large, batching: enabled, batch_window_ms: 12, max_batch_tokens: 8192, kv_retention_secs: default (not customized)
emma: I'll pull the trace in the console. can someone run the eval harness locally with the exact convo and model pinned to the pre-rollout image? need to repro before we escalate to infra. also open a support ticket to offer a quick workaround to the customer.
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary -> prod rollout completed by @devops at 2028-11-05T03:12:11Z, commit: 7c4e2d (gpu-kernel/kv-evict)
devon: if the commit touched eviction heuristics, quick mitigation = pin to older model variant (redwood-rt-1.9-stable) or set preserve_prefix_kv=true for that route. both are low-risk and reversible. can someone try preserve_prefix + disable aggressive batching for that org and report?
rachael: pinging infra team for an emergency config change. sending customer repro + recommended workaround now. i've asked CSM to offer temporary rollback or pinning. :pray:
samir: small repro note — the customer prompt is a long system prompt (~3.5k tokens) followed by a ~9k user history. with the new heuristic, KV entries for system-prefixed tokens were pruned earlier than before. this aligns with the bug. will prioritize a revert if we can't tweak heuristics safely.
kai: also add telemetry to detect missing-numbered-list pattern for regression alerts. we should catch this automatically for long-history threads.
emma: got the trace (trace_id: t-44f7). trace shows multiple evict events right before the request CPU spikes. attaching snippets to the ticket and to this thread. repro'd locally when I enabled the new kernel + long history; confirmed missing numbered list.
rachael: customer asked for ETA on fix, they flagged INC-2319 to priority-high. next steps?
devon: short-term: offer pin or preserve_prefix_kv for customer and rollback canary->prod for affected hosts. medium-term: revert eviction heuristic commit and run a controlled canary with extra evals for long-context instruction preservation.
samir: i'll open a PR to revert and request expedited review. will also add an automated regression test for system-prompt retention in conversations > 10k tokens.
rachael: thanks everyone. i've told the customer we'll offer model pin + a credit for the disruption. keeping thread updated here. :thumbsup:
